research_basis.adopted_design: LION's default open-discovery configuration uses Jaccard edge weights, minimum path aggregation, and sum accumulation across linking paths.
material_differences: LION uses sentence-level entity co-occurrence over a heterogeneous concept graph; this formula uses binary article-level MeSH descriptor co-occurrence.
LION's retrospective evaluation deletes documents where named A and C co-occur; this experiment retains every article and reports direct A-C counts.
LION's published aggregate results informed the formula choice, so this is a literature-grounded baseline rather than an independent method search.
The BioASQ cases and source counts are known, although no BioASQ metric output has been computed.

graph_contract.article_labels: binary unique descriptor set; duplicate assignments are an error
graph_contract.support: n_x is the number of included articles containing descriptor x
graph_contract.cooccurrence: n_xy is the number of included articles containing both distinct descriptors x and y
graph_contract.eligible_node_set: V_t contains every descriptor x with n_x >= threshold t
graph_contract.eligible_edge: An undirected edge (x,y) exists when x and y are distinct members of V_t and n_xy > 0
graph_contract.candidate_set: For seed A, rank every C in V_t except A, including candidates with a direct A-C edge.
graph_contract.bridge_set: For a candidate C, use every B in V_t except A and C where n_AB > 0 and n_BC > 0.
graph_contract.direct_ac_policy: Never delete A-C articles, never exclude C because n_AC > 0, report n_AC, and do not use n_AC as a separate score feature.

edge_weight.name: article_jaccard
edge_weight.domain: distinct eligible descriptors joined by an eligible edge
edge_weight.zero_policy: A missing edge contributes no path rather than an edge of weight zero.

path_and_candidate_score.candidate_formula: S(A,C) = sum(P(A,B,C) for B in bridge_set(A,C))
path_and_candidate_score.interpretation: A candidate scores highly when A and C have many shared linking descriptors with balanced Jaccard strength on both sides; this is a graph association measurement, not a generated hypothesis.

numeric_reproducibility.persisted_score_rounding: quantize once after the full sum using ROUND_HALF_EVEN

entries.potential_role: A separately pre-registered pilot over the measured secondary corpus after a successor semantics protocol explicitly handles its observed publication-year scope. It may support post-snapshot discovery cases but is not an NLM baseline substitute.
blockers: The acquired payload matches all three published aggregate counts, but its measured publication-year scope does not match the reported post-1949 scope: 280 records are dated 1946-1949. All years are parseable, although 751,238 values are not plain YYYY.

The 448-record balanced audit is consistent with meshMajor containing all assigned descriptors under maintained-current PubMed: 5,201 of 5,296 assignments match all descriptors and 455 match MajorTopicYN=Y headings. It is not population-weighted, period-appropriate, or evidence of corpus completeness.
The original 416-record protocol remains immutable. Its separately named 448-record successor and checksum-pinned bounded result retain every original threshold and contribute zero readiness.

A separate 21-case secondary-snapshot pilot is frozen before endpoint-support measurement or formula selection. Its five LION cases are source-labelled reproduction targets and its sixteen controls remain ontology-generated proposals, not independently validated discovery truth or verified absences.

The score-free full-snapshot audit found all 21 cases source-compatible at the primary minimum support of 10. However, held-out hard control generated-hard-2012-04-d019956-d019960 has target support exactly 10 and is ineligible at sensitivity 20. The frozen rule says an unevaluable sensitivity is not a pass, so this pilot cannot earn its passing label and does not authorize metric work.

A separately named source-informed successor now preserves all 21 cases and replaces the infeasible sensitivity 20 with sensitivity 5 while keeping primary support 10. It discloses every source count seen before freeze, labels held-out cases score-unseen rather than independent, and remains at zero readiness.

V2's initial formula is frozen before development output: article-level MeSH Jaccard edge weights, minimum aggregation along A-B-C paths, and sum accumulation across B. It is literature-grounded in LION's default but differs materially in graph and co-occurrence unit, retains direct A-C articles, and forbids held-out execution before a final formula freeze.
The measured secondary corpus is not the complete 21,508,439-record 2013 NLM baseline, and the two totals are not a measured coverage fraction.
Only a 2013 snapshot is relevant here, so it cannot supply the missing 2007, 2011, and 2012 releases.
Using it changes the experimental population and therefore requires a new pre-registration rather than a source-status flip.
entries.next_action: Preserve the sensitivity-blocked predecessor unchanged. Implement the frozen initial v2 Jaccard-sum-min formula and run only the 11 development cases at support 10 and 5 into a new refusal-to-overwrite review artifact. Do not compute, preview, cache, or persist held-out metric output until the final post-development formula contract is frozen.
